statement: For V=Sym^3(C^4), U=Sym^3(span(e_1,e_2,e_3)), and rho(X)=sum_{i,j} x_ij e_i partial/partial(e_j), there exist m_1,m_2 in mon(rho(sl_4(C))) with m_1 U+m_2 U=V; hence the monomial Lie-additive diameter in the frozen (n,k)=(4,3) cell is exactly 2. Specifically, m_1 is the identity and m_2=rho(X_1)rho(X_2)rho(X_3) for the three explicit traceless integer matrices in evidence/resolution_argument.md, with X_3 acting first.
contribution: This is a complete positive exact-certificate resolution of the single higher-rank cubic cell frozen in source.md, not of the universal all-(n,k) Question 8.5. Two structurally independent exact implementations give the same nonzero determinant 8412259151430144; the cited primary source poses the general question and treats only n=3. The bounded literature screen is not asserted to prove priority.
